data_policy: Only the 16 already-opened reference cases. No new prompts, task labels, training, thresholds, decoding changes or candidate selection.
precision: Both paths BF16, eager CPU, 8 threads, seed 0. Convert F32 standalone tensors to BF16; disable PEFT adapter autocast. This audits the composed profile, not upstream F32 accuracy.
measurements: Exact effective prompt tokens and recorded Switch activation starts for all 16 saved cases. Separately record default PEFT invocation detection; explicit offsets align standalone activation to Switch without changing prompts.
Exact backbone projection tensors under the published composition mapping.
All 320 adapter tensors equal BF16 standalone A and alpha/rank-scaled B, with exact zero padding and zero non-target MLP weights.
32 greedy generation calls: 16 standalone PEFT, 16 composed Switch; original 32-token cap and native prompts. Record actual PEFT offsets and Switch routes.
Exact text, generated tokens, termination and verdict comparisons; all 16 composed calls also compared to previous result including prompt tokens and routes.
Wall time, CPU time and cumulative process peak RSS. No isolated per-model peak claim.

decision.structural_mismatch: Stop with source/weight/invocation error. No inference repair or rerun under this freeze.
decision.prior_switch_replay_mismatch: Execution difference remains unresolved. No quality conclusion.
decision.paired_output_mismatch: Standalone and embedded implementations differ on opened cases; report all differences without electing a better output or changing thresholds.
decision.all_outputs_match: Same published adapter errors reproduced: stop loader/prompt diagnosis. No further invocation tuning. Future learning needs a separate prospective contract.

stop_rule: One committed, CI-green CPU allocation. Copy evidence and retire after completion or any failure. No automatic retries, training or A1 credit. Original reference failure remains unchanged.
invocation_policy: All 16 opened prompts tokenize <requirements>: with token 27916 for >:, so PEFT default detection of [27,71226,29] is inactive. Preserve exact prompts and weights. For standalone generation only, explicitly pass alora_offsets=[prompt_length-control_position] derived from the Switch control token, without expected labels. Record default offset and actual active offsets. This tests aligned activation, not automatic PEFT invocation.
